description: Validate an OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 schema (JSON or YAML text, for example the schema from a custom GPT Action) and show the MCP tools it converts to: tool names, HTTP method and path, read-only or destructive hints, detected authentication, and any errors or warnings. Use this when someone wants to migrate a custom GPT Action or turn an OpenAPI spec into an MCP server. Nothing is stored and the API is not called.

schema.description: The complete OpenAPI schema text (JSON or YAML).

name: preview_openapi_conversion
title: Preview OpenAPI to MCP conversion
